data.narrative:
Monaire is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Nishant Kanapilly and Rahul Subramany, having raised $4.1M to date. The climate and energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis. Using the $4.1M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a typical seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $10.2M. The peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient narrow comparables; while eight same-sector companies exist, none satisfied the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum needed for reliable benchmarking.

The triangulated range supported by this analysis is $9M to $12M, with a median of $10M. This range reflects the step-up methodology only. The primary uncertainty is the absence of direct seed-stage climate tech peers at comparable capital levels, which limits the ability to validate the 2.5x step-up multiplier against market precedent. A fuller valuation would benefit from tighter peer selection as Monaire progresses toward later funding rounds, when adjacent comparables become available.
